PC: Recognize, treat hypothermia (move patient away from water, provide shelter, replace wet clothing with dry)
Recognize signs and symptoms, and management of concussion.
SBP: Assess and constantly reassess the scene for safety
Activate EMS as soon as cell service is available
Assess both the scene and the status of the patient to determine the safest manner of evacuating
ICS: Assign clear team roles and responsibilities
Communicate effectively as a team, including using directed, closed-loop communication
Give comprehensive patient sign-out to Medic
Approach patient in non-threatening way using appropriate communication
Keep patient updated with medical management in a level of detail appropriate to their level of understanding
Obtain consent to treat and proceed when possible
